15. Davinci Resolve - Video editing with AI features.

summary.name: DaVinci Resolve
summary.one_liner: DaVinci Resolve is Blackmagic Design's all-in-one professional video editing, color grading, visual effects, motion graphics, audio post production and photo editing application, with a free version and a paid Studio version.
keywords: video editing for mac windows linux
use_cases: editing feature films and television shows
color grading footage to a look
creating visual effects and motion graphics
mixing and mastering audio for video
collaborating on a project with remote editors and colorists
editing multicam and live broadcast replays
summary.what_it_does: The page describes DaVinci Resolve as one application combining editing, color correction, visual effects, motion graphics, audio post production and, in version 21, photo editing, organized into pages such as Cut, Edit, Fusion, Color, Fairlight, Media and Deliver. The Fusion page uses a node-based workflow for 2D and 3D effects, tracking and keying, and the Fairlight page offers DAW-style audio mixing with support for up to 2,000 tracks. Multi-user collaboration lets editors, colorists, VFX artists and sound engineers work on the same project through project libraries and Blackmagic Cloud. The page also lists hardware control options: Speed Editor, Replay Editor, Editor Keyboard, color panels and Fairlight consoles, sold separately with prices from $225 to $5,225 among the listed items.
notable: Free version with multi-user collaboration and HDR grading; DaVinci Resolve Studio adds more effects, AI Neural Engine, 10-bit and beyond-4K support
Fusion node-based visual effects and motion graphics page
Fairlight audio post production with DAW-style tools and immersive audio formats
Hardware control surfaces such as Speed Editor and color panels
caveats: Studio version is paid; the free version has limits such as 8-bit formats up to 60fps and resolutions up to Ultra HD 3840 x 2160
Hardware panels and consoles are sold separately and are optional
Some Studio features such as 3D and text-based editing are listed only for Studio
